subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should issue #38327 remain the canonical tracker for both the Google Vertex thinking-payload sanitizer slice and the native ADC dependency/auth-stack crash, or should maintainers split those into separate items?
rationale: The issue has overlapping open and merged work, but source and dependency evidence do not prove a complete fix and the remaining boundary depends on maintainer-owned provider/auth policy plus credentialed Vertex proof.

options.title: Keep one canonical tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical tracker until live Vertex ADC proof covers the active runtime and maintainers decide how to land or retire the sanitizer slice.

options.title: Split sanitizer from auth stack
options.body: Create or designate a separate canonical item for the native Google auth/gaxios fetch dependency path and let PR #83991 address only the sanitizer behavior.

options.title: Accept partial fix as enough
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers explicitly accept the merged ADC support plus current packages/ai behavior as sufficient despite missing live proof for the reported crash.

recommendation.title: Keep one canonical tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical tracker until live Vertex ADC proof covers the active runtime and maintainers decide how to land or retire the sanitizer slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest merged ownership signal is the recent production ADC support work in the Google Vertex plugin.
